# context-stack-mcp

> Read-only MCP endpoint for the Context Stack: ContextOps, ContextBoundary, Sthala, Griha, and canonical stack doctrine.

context-stack-mcp exposes public resources, prompts, and safe guidance tools for AI clients. It does not store user prompts or assessment answers by default.

License: Apache 2.0. Status: v0.1 local implementation.

## Core

- [README.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack-mcp/blob/main/README.md): Project overview and local usage
- [src/mcp/handler.js](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack-mcp/blob/main/src/mcp/handler.js): MCP JSON-RPC method handler
- [src/stack-catalog.js](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack-mcp/blob/main/src/stack-catalog.js): Stack project catalog and resource map
- [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack-mcp/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): Deployment and DNS notes
- [docs/PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack-mcp/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md): Privacy posture
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Security posture and reporting

## Related projects

- [context-stack](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack): Canonical terminology, locked decisions, and family framing
- [ContextOps](https://github.com/kannanokannan/ContextOps): AI context governance framework
- [ContextBoundary](https://github.com/kannanokannan/ContextBoundary): Egress governance specification for AI data flows
- [Sthala](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala): Governed AI runtime placement reference
- [Griha](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Griha): Product/adoption layer above the governance stack
